Set up the library

UMF isn't published as an installable package yet. Clone the repository and use Bun to install dependencies and build the browser library.

git clone https://github.com/DocumentDrivenDX/umf.git
cd umf
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run typecheck
bun run build

The setup guide also covers browser tests and native tools used to check adapters.

Read, validate and write

import { readDocument, validateDocument, writeDocument }
  from './src/index.ts';

const document = readDocument(sourceText, 'json');
const result = validateDocument(document);
const yaml = writeDocument(document, 'yaml');

readDocument parses the input and rejects invalid documents. validateDocument returns diagnostics and two flags:

  • valid: no known errors were found.
  • complete: all declared content was checked.

An unknown extension can leave valid true and complete false. Its content is preserved, but the library hasn't verified its meaning. Try that example in the playground.

writeDocument writes JSON or YAML. It preserves document values; whitespace, comments and key order may change.

Inspect a schema in the browser

The schema explorer lets you browse domain packs and inspect shared metadata, native declarations and retained extensions. Follow a definition or table reference to see its details, or download the original schema.

Open a local JSON or YAML file to inspect your own schema. Validation messages identify content the library could not interpret; inspection does not imply that a database enforces a declaration.
